title: How a Sink P-Trap Seals Out Sewer Air
description: A sink P-trap relies on a simple yet critical physical principle to protect indoor air quality. The dip in the trap retains a standing column of water after each use. This remaining water creates an airtight liquid seal between the living space and the sewer system, preventing toxic gases, unpleasant odors, and pests from escaping up through the drain opening. For a P-trap to function reliably, it must be installed level, properly vented, and fitted with the correct tailpiece depth to prevent self-siphonage and preserve the water seal.
